description: Like request_order, but the customer pays now. Only when products or catalog show payments.online true and the estimate has fixed prices. Same inputs, after the customer approves the itemized total. With shared_payment_token (a Stripe token you issued to payments.agent_pay.network_business_profile for this total in usd) it charges at once: payment_status paid, requires_action for a card check, or an error (retry with a new token and the same request_key). Without one it returns checkout_url for the customer to pay on Stripe. Never ask for or pass card numbers. The money goes to the business; it confirms timing in the conversation. No stock hold.
